messages:
Ellen: Morning! Did a desk reorg and now my monitor lineup looks like a skyline. Pics later.
Marco: drop pic! I want to see the skyline.
Tala: quick PSA: had a 15min wifi drop during standup. ISP "FastHome" claimed "maintenance" but no email. Switched to tether.
ops-bot: network-monitor: observed 3 short disconnects for ISP "FastHome" in 94105 between 09:12-09:28 UTC.
Ellen: thanks ops-bot. Good reminder to keep a spare ethernet adapter handy.
Marco: pic uploaded. also, plant placement caused monitor wobble. pro tip: use a coaster under the pot.
Tala: poll: who has a dedicated home office vs couch or kitchen? react :one: office :two: couch :three: kitchen
Ellen: :one: finally.
Marco: :two: until plant knocks me off the couch.
Tala: collage coming to #all-hands tomorrow for 'worst/best WFH posture' contest. winner gets office hero emoji.
Ellen: prize = instant respect.
Marco: can the emoji be a tiny stack of monitors?
ops-bot: reminder: upload images with a brief caption so alt-text is helpful for accessibility.
